adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new admin embedding UI/API plumbing (adminEmbedding route/template, admin/adapters/embedding pathFor -> "/admin/customize/embedding", Admin::EmbeddingController#show/#update rendering an OpenStruct via EmbeddingSerializer with `embed: :ids`, and new plural `_ids` hydration logic in `store.js`). The only new controller specs are subclass checks (no requests to `show`/`update`), and there are no tests covering the `/admin/customize/embedding` route, the serializer output contract (e.g., `embeddable_host_ids`), or the saveChanges PUT round-trip (`admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` calls `embedding.update({})` while `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` just re-renders). This is a specific, diff-grounded test coverage gap that could allow a key/route/serializer change to break the admin UI without CI failing, even if it’s not a direct functional defect by itself.
